title: 桜島の火山灰に悩む鹿児島県民に朗報　月額980円から使い放題の「洗車サブスク」が登場
extracted_text: 鹿児島で車を持つ人なら誰もが頭を抱える問題がある。桜島の火山灰だ。洗車したばかりの車が、翌日にはうっすら灰をかぶっている——そんな経験を繰り返してきた県民に、うってつけのサービスが登場した。月額定額で何度でも洗車できる「洗車のサブスク」である。 2026年3月、鹿児島市中山町にオープンした洗車専門店「スプラッシュンゴー鹿児島 中山店」。平日の午前中から次々と車が訪れるこの店舗の目玉は、敷地内に設置された全長15メートルの大型洗車機だ。 「トンネル式で連続洗車機といいます。3分で洗車が終わる」と話すのは、同店代表の上山洋輔さん。ベルトコンベアで車をゆっくり前進させながら、約3分間で洗い上げるこの洗車機は、鹿児島県内では初登場となる。 実際に体験してみると、進み始めた直後から目の前にブラシが現れ、車体をみるみる包み込む。周囲の景色が次々と変わっていく様子は、まるでアトラクションのような感覚だ。 一般的な洗車機は車を1台ずつ洗う仕組みのため、1時間に洗えるのはせいぜい9台ほど。しかしトンネル型の連続洗車機は、車が次々と流れる構造のため、1時間に最大60台を洗うことができる。待ち時間の大幅な短縮につながるのは明らかだ。 火山灰が降るたびに洗車したくても、長い列に並ぶのが億劫で後回しにしてしまう——そんな悩みも、この仕組みなら解消できる可能性がある。 この店舗のもう一つの大きな特徴が「洗車のサブスク」だ。月額980円から契約でき、期間中は何度でも洗車機を利用できる。 利用者からは「月額で何度でもできるというのは魅力」「きょうは待ち時間がなかった。4月は4、5回来た」といった声が聞かれる。頻繁に洗車が必要な鹿児島の気候風土にマッチした料金体系だといえる。 スプラッシュンゴー鹿児島 中山店によると、洗車機の需要は本社がある群馬県と比較して、鹿児島は1.7倍にのぼるという。桜島を抱える土地柄が、データにも如実に表れている。 上山代表は「火山灰が降っても雨が降っても、いつでも洗車ができる洗車場を目指したい」と語る。今後もサブスク利用者の増加を見込んでおり、地域のニーズに応えるサービスとして定着させていく考えだ。
translated_text:
There is a problem that any car owner in Kagoshima has had to deal with — Sakurajima's volcanic ash. Even right after washing your car, the next day it becomes covered in a thin layer of ash. For residents who have repeatedly experienced this, a perfect service has arrived: a "car wash subscription" that allows unlimited washes for a fixed monthly fee.

Splashun Go Kagoshima Nakayama Store opened in Nakayama-cho, Kagoshima City in March 2026. The store's main attraction is a massive 15-meter-long car wash machine installed on the premises, with cars arriving one after another from mid-morning on weekdays.

"This is what's called a tunnel-style continuous car wash machine. It finishes in 3 minutes," says Yosuke Kamiyama, the store's representative. Using a conveyor belt to slowly move cars forward, this wash machine completes the process in about 3 minutes, and it is the first of its kind in Kagoshima Prefecture.

Actually experiencing it, brushes appear right as the car starts moving, quickly enveloping the vehicle's body. The surrounding scenery changing one after another feels like being on an attraction.

Regular car wash machines wash one car at a time, so they can handle at most about 9 cars per hour. But the tunnel-style continuous wash machine can handle up to 60 cars per hour due to its structure of cars flowing through one after another. This clearly leads to a significant reduction in wait times.

The hassle of having to wash your car every time volcanic ash falls, but being deterred by long queues and putting it off — that problem could be solved with this system.

Another major feature of this store is the "car wash subscription." You can sign up from ¥980 per month, and during the contract period, you can use the car wash machine as many times as you want.

Users have said things like, "The fact that you can wash as many times as you want for a monthly fee is appealing," and "Today there was no wait time. I came 4 or 5 times in April." It's a pricing system that fits well with Kagoshima's climate and conditions where frequent washing is necessary.

According to Splashun Go Kagoshima Nakayama Store, car wash machine demand in Kagoshima is 1.7 times higher compared to Gunma Prefecture, where the company's headquarters is located. The fact that the area includes Sakurajima is clearly reflected in the data.

Representative Kamiyama says, "We want to create a car wash facility where you can wash your car anytime, whether volcanic ash falls or rain falls." They expect the number of subscription users to continue growing, aiming to establish the service as one that meets the needs of the local community.
title_en: Good News for Kagoshima Residents Plagued by Sakurajima Volcanic Ash — Unlimited Car Wash Subscription Launches from ¥980/Month
